transitionStructuredPlan.summary: Transitioning from Retail Associate to Electrician in Ontario, Canada requires completing secondary school and confirming regional trade certification and licensing requirements. The path typically takes 13-15 months to reach an entry-level role, starting with securing a helper or apprentice position. Building practical skills and meeting formal credential gates are essential. Communication, reliability, and attention to detail are key soft skills. Initial wages range from $18 to $24 USD/hour, increasing to $26 to $31 USD/hour once fully qualified.
